name: ship
description: Verify, review, and publish a finished coding change without merging its pull request.

interface.shortDescription: Verify and publish finished coding changes
interface.longDescription: Rebase onto the base branch, run project quality gates, review the diff, update task status, publish a pull request, and drive checks and feedback to green. $drive-pr runs the same stabilization on any open pull request, and $rebase brings a branch up to date with its base, adapting the change to what landed upstream.
defaultPrompt: Use $ship to verify and publish my finished change.
Use $drive-pr to drive this pull request to green.
Use $rebase to bring this branch up to date with main.
Use $ship refresh config to re-detect this repository's workflow.
